desc_en: A grounded, North Macedonia-specific product demo following one recurring hero in a real Skopje riverside setting, then a clean studio finish. One consistent massage gun model is shown step-by-step: calf, shoulder, then a final premium rotation. No stock-gym clichés, no signage, no shape-shifting product.
music: Minimal minimalist electronic pulse with warm Balkan percussion accents, 98 bpm, clean and modern
vo_mk: По трчање покрај Вардар, телото бара пауза.
Стави го на листот — длабоко, рамномерно пулсира.
Потоа на рамото — тензијата попушта за миг.
Три нивоа, еден уред — секогаш под контрола.

shots.kf: Photorealistic wide-medium shot on Vardar quay in Skopje at golden hour. Same hero throughout: athletic woman, late 20s, dark hair in low ponytail, charcoal hoodie, black leggings, neutral sneakers. She sits on a concrete step by the river, breathing calmly, unbranded matte-black massage gun in hand. Balkan concrete textures, soft warm sun, shallow depth, no readable text or logos.
shots.motion: She exhales and places the massage gun against her calf to start. Camera makes a slow dolly-in of about one meter, keeping her hands and device centered, stable and natural.

shots.kf: Photorealistic close-up of the same woman’s lower leg and hands on the Vardar quay. The exact same matte-black massage gun model is pressed to the calf muscle, angled slightly upward. Skin detail natural, hands simple and clear, no jewelry. Background falls into creamy bokeh with river reflections and stone textures, warm sunset palette of amber, slate gray, and muted blue.
shots.motion: She glides the device slowly upward along the calf in one continuous pass. Camera performs a gentle lateral slide to the right about 30 cm, maintaining focus on the moving contact point.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium close-up, same location and wardrobe. The woman has shifted her hoodie slightly off one shoulder and applies the same massage gun to the top of her shoulder/trapezius. Her face is partially visible in profile, expression relaxed and unambiguous. Soft rim light from low sun outlines her hair; background is out-of-focus riverbank and stone railing, no signage.
shots.motion: She moves the device in a small, controlled circle on the shoulder for one cycle. Camera tilts up subtly from the device to her calm face, then holds steady, all within five seconds.

shots.kf: Photorealistic macro close-up of the massage gun’s control area in her hands, still outdoors on the quay. The gun body is identical; the interface shows three simple, non-text indicators (no letters or numbers). Her thumb taps one button once. Color palette stays warm-neutral; background is creamy bokeh of sunset tones, no readable elements, no logos.
shots.motion: Her thumb presses the button once, and the indicator lights shift one step. Camera makes a slow push-in a few centimeters, keeping the button press and light change perfectly centered and readable.

shots.kf: Photorealistic studio hero shot on a matte dark-slate tabletop with a matching dark-slate background, controlled softbox lighting from above-left and subtle rim from behind. The same unbranded matte-black massage gun stands upright, perfectly clean, consistent proportions. No other props, no text, no logos. Crisp highlights define the silhouette; palette is graphite, soft silver, and deep shadow for a premium finish.
shots.motion: The massage gun rotates smoothly on a hidden turntable by about 120 degrees. Camera performs a slow, steady arc to match the rotation, keeping the product centered and sharp the entire time.
